units.source_text: 白天，前田六段只同名人夫人谈了片刻，便急匆匆地离开了旅馆。

en.t: During the day, Maeda 6-dan spoke only briefly with the Master's wife, then hurriedly left the inn.

units.source_text: 对前田六段来说，名人是他的师傅，大竹七段是他的师兄，他是担心万一被人误解和非议，才避免同对弈者会面的。

en.t: For Maeda 6-dan, the Master was his teacher and Otake 7-dan was his senior fellow pupil; he avoided meeting the players because he feared he might be misunderstood and criticized.

units.source_text: 也许是想起有人风传名人同吴清源五段对弈时白160的绝着是前田六段发现的，他才这样做。

en.t: Perhaps he acted this way because he remembered the rumor that, when the Master played against Go Seigen 5-dan, White 160, the brilliant move, had been discovered by Maeda 6-dan.
